name: probe_bce_aux
description: gAUC trade-off probe: default recipe (bal+margin+biln+hard) with an added BCE auxiliary term at weight 0.5 on top of the margin loss. Goal: measure whether gAUC can be pulled toward the DTI-literature standard (≥ 0.80) without collapsing matrix-ranking metrics. Diagnostic run, NOT a paper ablation.
